brand.footer: A Still Point tool · Adapted from Zach Salter's Finance Office Field Manual

pricing.note: Set these prices here. The UI reads single_card_display and unlimited_display for the button labels. The cents values are what you will wire into Stripe later. They are not used to compute UI text.

founder_passes.note: Replace this with a real founder email. Use YYYY-MM-DD for a timed free pass.

access.instructions: To give a founder free access, add a new object to founder_passes with their email and an expires date. Leave expires blank for no expiration.
